name: fjgo
description: Forgejo repository operations for coding agents through the fjgo CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Work with Forgejo repositories through an agent-first CLI.
interface.longDescription: Inspect and manage Forgejo issues, pull requests, Actions, releases, and repository settings with compact output, token-safe previews, and explicit write authorization. Authentication uses locally configured FJGO_HOST and FJGO_TOKEN environment variables; the plugin does not provide OAuth or store credentials.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this Forgejo repository and summarize its open work.
Triage open Forgejo issues and propose priorities.
Preview a safe fjgo mutation for this repository.
